history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: this row ('Prakasheshwar Temple (Shiv Mandir)') is the same temple as seq 1107 (id shri-prakasheshwar-mahadev-mandir-dehradun), which documents it in full under the name 'Shri Prakasheshwar Mahadev Mandir' with 'Shiv Mandir (Mussoorie Road)' as an alternate name - exactly the parenthetical in the CSV. It is the famous privately (family) owned Shiva temple at Kuthal Gate on the Dehradun-Mussoorie Road, locally known simply as 'Shiv Mandir'. Its signature feature is a strict no-donation policy: no donation boxes anywhere, and money or offerings are refused (even anonymous ones); free tea and bhandara are served daily. The sanctum houses a sphatik (crystal) shivlinga. FLAG carried over from seq 1107: the >1,000-year age claim and 'millions of years old shivlinga' claim are not substantiated by any historical source (verify).

town_description: Dehradun is the capital city of Uttarakhand, set in the Doon Valley at the foothills of the Himalayas. Known as the 'School Capital of India' with institutions like The Doon School and the Forest Research Institute, it is also the gateway to the hill station of Mussoorie and a base for Char Dham pilgrims.

travel.road: On Mussoorie Road at Kuthal Gate, 12 km from Dehradun city; well connected by bus, taxi and car
